text:
anna: Quick check — planning to enable 'multi-region-fallback-v2' in prod for EU->NA as a controlled canary. Start at 2% session share, maintain sticky sessions via X-Session-ID, stickiness TTL 30m. Need sign-off on scope, guardrails, and rollback plan.

mike: Which routes/models are in scope? Is this using the quantized variant? :thinking:

anna: Scope = conversational + chat endpoints behind /api/v1/chat. Fallback targets: 'rwdx-1.2' (q4_0 quantized) and 'rwdx-1.2-small' for cost-sensitive bursts. We'll keep primary model affinity where latency matters.

sarah: Two ops notes: 1) KV-cache keys must include model+region to avoid cache pollution. 2) Add guardrail: p95 latency <= 800ms; if breached auto-alert + manual rollback.

raj: Can you prepare a rollback toggle and a smoke window? I'd prefer a 10:30–11:00 UTC smoke window tomorrow and pager duty owner. Also confirm alert thresholds.

anna: Rollback toggle exists: 'multi_region_fallback_v2.disable' in the FF dashboard. I'll create the alert runbook and tag @raj as pager. Smoke window works for our team.

sarah: Ops command for the canary (for oncall/SRE):
```
ffctl toggle multi_region_fallback_v2 --env prod --on --scope "canary:eu:2%" --meta "owner=anna,canary=eu-fb-1"
```

sarah: Rollback command: 
```
ffctl toggle multi_region_fallback_v2 --env prod --off
```

tom: SRE plan: we'll drain one instance group before flipping the flag, watch queue depth + p99 latency, and have a hot rollback step. I'll add a short playbook run for this.

linda: Product question: any user-visible differences? Will customers see changed responses or increased errors? :eyes:

anna: No UX changes intended. Fallback will only change model behind the scenes; traces will include a `fallback_reason` tag. We won't log customer content (PII-safe). Support traces will include metadata for debugging.

mike: Also pinging @devex to update docs and @sre for playbook. PR is open: https://git.redwood/s/repo/pulls/1420 — contains the routing-policy and affinity changes. Please review.

sre-bot: New alert created: FallbackLatency-EU-Prod (trigger: p95 > 800ms). Pager: @raj. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/fallback-latency

raj: I'll be on-call during the smoke window. If p95 > 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes, trigger rollback and notify infra.

anna: Ramp plan: start 02:00 UTC at 2% for 30m. If p95 < 600ms and error delta < 0.5% then ramp to 10%. After 2 hours of stable metrics, final ramp to 20%. If any threshold trips, rollback to off and investigate.

mike: LGTM. @sarah @tom please check PR-1420 comments and confirm.

sarah: Reviewing now, will leave inline comments.

anna: Thanks everyone — I'll post a short pre-flip status in #eng-platform 5m before starting. :rocket:
